name: after the bell
source:
You play as a recently deceased student who can’t remember her name and upon awakening as a ghost, she feels a strong urge to return to her school to look for her real name. explore the school, talk to a few other ghostly students, maybe grab some things for them and uncover your name!

This game features a small bonus folder for when you achieve the true ending.
translation:
你扮演一个最近去世的学生，她不记得自己的名字，当她作为鬼魂醒来时，她强烈渴望回到学校寻找她的真名。探索学校，与其他一些幽灵学生交谈，也许可以为他们拿一些东西并揭开你的名字！

这个游戏有一个小的奖励文件夹，当你达到真正的结局时。
